mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.md_content, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.cover_image, a.image_keys, a.create_time
a.id, a.title, SUBSTRING(a.md_content, 1, 300) AS md_content, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.cover_image, a.create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM article a
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{titleKey}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM article_tag at JOIN tag t ON at.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tag_alias ta ON ta.tag_id = t.id WHERE at.article_id = a.id AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tagKey}, '%') OR ta.alias_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tagKey}, '%')) )

SELECT FROM article a
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{titleKey}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM article_tag at JOIN tag t ON at.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tag_alias ta ON ta.tag_id = t.id WHERE at.article_id = a.id AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tagKey}, '%') OR ta.alias_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tagKey}, '%')) )
ORDER BY ${sortField} ${sortOrder} LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, md_content, cover_image, image_keys, view_count, like_count, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{mdContent}, #{coverImage}, #{imageKeys}, 0, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE article SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
